highlights: 合并上游 1.6.11 全部新特性：未分配工作区不再丢弃轮换 Cookie（MuseSessionUnavailable + cookie_sink 持久化）。
图片/视频独立排队时限（默认 3600 秒，0 为不限）；排队不消耗生成预算，失败记录保留账号、尝试次数与原始错误。
媒体库视频缩略图（懒加载，Docker 镜像已含 FFmpeg）与 /admin/generation-queue 排队设置端点。
浏览器插件升级至 1.0.3：按当前普通/无痕窗口读取 Cookie，找不到存储区时停止导入。
patch21（事故封堵）：静默自更新默认永久关闭（MUSE2API_AUTO_UPGRADE 显式开启才生效）——2026-11-16 Tarball 覆盖事故根因修复，本 fork 补丁不在上游，任何自动覆盖都会整树回退。
继续保留二开 7-20 全部补丁：TetherPool 出口托管、per-account 指纹隔离、幂等/并发/重绑/attempt 审计等。
highlights_en: Merged upstream 1.6.11: cookies rotated by unassigned-workspace responses are preserved via MuseSessionUnavailable and the cookie sink.
Image/video queue waits have a separate budget (3600s default; 0 = unlimited); failed tasks retain account, attempt and original error.
Lazy video thumbnails in the media library (Docker image ships FFmpeg) plus the /admin/generation-queue settings endpoints.
Extension 1.0.3 reads the active regular/incognito window cookie store and stops on identification failure.

patch21 (incident hardening): the silent self-updater is now disabled by default (opt-in via MUSE2API_AUTO_UPGRADE) — root cause of the 2026-11-16 tarball-overwrite outage; this fork's patches never exist upstream.
All local patches 7-20 remain: TetherPool egress management, per-account fingerprint isolation, idempotency, concurrency, rebind and attempt audit.
